en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 27 points at 22384 as auto stocks lag
en.dek: The index ended Monday 0.12 per cent lower after recovering from a morning drop of more than 400 points, with Lenovo among the strongest gainers.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed at 22383.74 points on Monday, down 27 points or 0.12 per cent, after falling as much as 410 points in early trade and briefly trading below 22000.
The Hang Seng Tech Index finished nearly flat at 3508 points. Automakers were among the weaker performers, while Lenovo rose nearly 8 per cent and was one of the best-performing blue chips.
Turnover on the main board was about HK$253 billion. The index had opened lower amid continued pressure on technology shares linked to AI valuations.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌27點報22384 汽車股受壓
zh.dek: 周一恒生指數收市跌0.12%，早段曾跌逾400點失守22000點，聯想集團升近8%成表現最好藍籌之一。
body: 恒生指數周一收市報22383.74點，跌27點或0.12%，早段最多跌逾410點並一度失守22000點，午後跌幅收窄。
恒生科技指數收市報3508點，大致持平。汽車股普遍受壓，聯想集團則升近8%，是表現較佳的藍籌股之一。
主板成交額約2531億元。指數早段受科技股持續受人工智能估值壓力影響而偏軟。
